subject: WL
title: Spanish 1A
description: Spanish 1A is the first half of Spanish I, taking students from Novice Low to Novice Mid. Students learn greetings, numbers, dates, time, weather, personal description with ser, likes with gustar, school vocabulary, food, family, places in town, and present-tense regular -ar/-er/-ir verbs plus tener, estar, and ir (with ir a + infinitive). Culture threads include the 21 Spanish-speaking countries, greeting customs, school life, regional foods, family naming customs, and town plazas. Spanish 1B in grade 8 completes Spanish I.
framework: 2019 California World Languages Standards; 2020 CA World Languages Framework (Novice Low to Novice Mid)

standards.WL-COMM1-NL: Interpretive communication (Novice Low): recognize familiar words and memorized phrases in simple spoken and written texts.
standards.WL-COMM2-NL: Interpersonal communication (Novice Low): greet, introduce oneself, and answer simple questions using memorized words and phrases.
standards.WL-COMM3-NL: Presentational communication (Novice Low): present basic information about oneself using memorized words and phrases.
standards.WL-COMM1-NM: Interpretive communication (Novice Mid): understand words, phrases, and some simple sentences in texts on familiar topics.
standards.WL-COMM2-NM: Interpersonal communication (Novice Mid): exchange information on familiar topics using practiced phrases and simple questions.
standards.WL-COMM3-NM: Presentational communication (Novice Mid): present information on familiar topics using practiced phrases and some simple sentences.
standards.WL-CULT1-NM: Cultures (Novice Mid): identify products and practices of Spanish-speaking cultures and compare them with one's own.
standards.WL-CULT2-NM: Intercultural interaction (Novice Mid): use culturally appropriate gestures, greetings, and forms of address in familiar situations.
standards.WL-STRUC1-NL: Structures (Novice Low): use sound-symbol correspondence, numbers, and memorized patterns to communicate.
standards.WL-STRUC1-NM: Structures (Novice Mid): use gender/number agreement, articles, and regular and common irregular present-tense verbs to communicate.
standards.WL-CONN1-NM: Connections (Novice Mid): use Spanish to reinforce knowledge of geography, science, and health.

units.title: ¡Hola! Greetings and the Spanish-Speaking World
units.big_idea: Greetings, names, and numbers open every conversation, and Spanish connects us to 21 countries.

units.title: El calendario, la hora y el tiempo
units.big_idea: Dates, time, and weather organize daily life, and seasons differ across hemispheres.

units.title: ¿Cómo eres? Describing People
units.big_idea: Ser and agreeing adjectives let us describe who people are.

units.title: Me gusta: Activities and Free Time
units.big_idea: Sharing likes and dislikes builds friendships across cultures.

units.title: La escuela
units.big_idea: Talking about school introduces regular -ar verbs and numbers to 100.

units.title: ¡A comer! Food and Healthy Eating
units.big_idea: Food reveals culture; -er and -ir verbs let us talk about what we eat and drink.

units.title: Mi familia
units.big_idea: Families and their celebrations are central to identity in Spanish-speaking cultures.

units.title: Mi ciudad: Places and Directions
units.big_idea: Estar and ir help us locate places and move through a community.

units.title: El tiempo libre: Sports, Plans, and Invitations
units.big_idea: Ir a + infinitive lets us make plans and invite others.

units.title: Repaso y evaluación final
units.big_idea: We show what we can do in Spanish across all three modes.

days.title: Saludos
days.work: Watch a short greeting dialogue, then practice hola, buenos días/tardes/noches aloud and label a time-of-day chart with the right greeting.

days.title: ¿Cómo te llamas?
days.work: Practice the exchange ¿Cómo te llamas? / Me llamo... / Mucho gusto / Igualmente with a parent playing a new classmate; record it twice.

days.title: Despedidas
days.work: Learn adiós, hasta luego, hasta mañana, nos vemos; write and act out three 4-line mini-dialogues that open with a greeting and close with a farewell.

days.title: Culture: el saludo
days.work: Read about greeting customs (handshake, cheek kiss in Spain and much of Latin America) and compare them with greetings in your family in a two-column chart.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Complete Duolingo's first unit and perform an unscripted greet-introduce-farewell exchange with a parent.

weeks.assessment: Oral exchange checklist: greets, gives name, responds to mucho gusto, uses a farewell.

weeks.topic: ¿Cómo estás? Feelings and formal vs. informal address
objectives: Ask how someone is and respond

days.title: ¿Cómo estás?
days.work: Learn bien, muy bien, regular, mal, así así and practice responding to ¿Cómo estás? with emoji cards drawn at random.

days.title: Tú vs. usted
days.work: Sort 12 people (best friend, grandmother, doctor, teacher, cousin) into tú or usted and write the matching greeting for each.

days.title: Listening
days.work: Watch a Spanish Proficiency Exercises (UT Austin) greeting clip twice and note each speaker's name and how they feel.

days.title: Role-play
days.work: Role-play meeting a neighbor (usted) and then a new teammate (tú), switching the forms correctly.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a 15-item quiz matching questions to responses and choosing tú/usted, then do a 1-minute oral check-in with a parent.

objectives: Spell names using the Spanish alphabet

days.title: El alfabeto
days.work: Learn the Spanish alphabet with a song, then practice the five pure vowel sounds and the letters ñ, ll, rr, j, and h (silent).

days.title: ¿Cómo se escribe?
days.work: Spell your full name, your town, and five family members' names aloud; a parent writes what they hear to check accuracy.

days.title: Números 0–15
days.work: Learn numbers 0–15 and play a card game (draw two cards, say the sum in Spanish) for 15 minutes.

days.title: Números 16–31
days.work: Learn 16–31 (dieciséis, veintiuno), then do a listening dictation of 15 phone-style number strings.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a spelling dictation of 8 Spanish words and a numbers 0–31 listening quiz.

weeks.assessment: Spelling dictation and number listening quiz.

objectives: Identify the 21 Spanish-speaking countries and capitals

days.title: Mapa
days.work: Label the 21 Spanish-speaking countries and their capitals on a blank map, color-coding Spain, Mexico/Central America, the Caribbean, South America, and Equatorial Guinea.

days.title: ¿De dónde eres?
days.work: Practice ¿De dónde eres? / Soy de... and learn that Spanish is spoken widely in California and the U.S.; list five California place names of Spanish origin.

days.title: Map quiz practice
days.work: Use an online map game or flashcards to drill countries and capitals until you can place all 21 in under five minutes.

days.title: Presentación
days.work: Write and record a self-introduction: greeting, name, how you are, age in numbers, where you are from, and farewell.

days.title: Unit 1 assessment
days.work: Take the unit test (greetings listening, numbers, alphabet, map of 21 countries) and submit the recorded introduction.

weeks.assessment: Unit 1 test and presentational recording rubric.

weeks.topic: Los días, los meses y la fecha
objectives: Say and write dates and birthdays

days.title: Los días
days.work: Learn the days of the week (lowercase, week starts on lunes) and write tomorrow/today/yesterday statements: Hoy es martes, mañana es miércoles.

days.title: Los meses
days.work: Learn the 12 months and fill in a blank Spanish calendar for this month with family events.

days.title: La fecha
days.work: Learn the date format (el 5 de mayo, el primero de enero) and write 10 family birthdays: El cumpleaños de mi mamá es el....

days.title: Culture: días festivos
days.work: Read about three holidays (16 de septiembre, 12 de octubre, 6 de enero Día de Reyes) and mark them on your calendar with a one-line note each.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Answer ¿Qué día es hoy? and ¿Cuál es la fecha? orally for five random dates and take a written dates quiz.

weeks.assessment: Dates quiz and oral calendar questions.

objectives: Tell time on the hour, half hour, and quarter hour
Say at what time events happen

days.title: ¿Qué hora es?
days.work: Build a paper-plate clock and practice es la una / son las... with y cuarto, y media, and menos diez.

days.title: Times of day
days.work: Add de la mañana, de la tarde, de la noche and write the time of 10 daily events on your own schedule.

days.title: ¿A qué hora?
days.work: Contrast ¿Qué hora es? with ¿A qué hora es...?; ask a parent five questions about family events and record answers.

days.title: 24-hour clock
days.work: Read a Spanish train timetable or TV listing that uses 24-hour time and convert 10 times into spoken Spanish.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a listening quiz (hear a time, draw the clock hands) and say the time for 10 clocks.

weeks.assessment: Time listening quiz and oral clock reading.

objectives: Compare seasons in the northern and southern hemispheres

days.title: El tiempo
days.work: Learn hace calor/frío/sol/viento, llueve, nieva, está nublado and give a daily weather report for your town.

days.title: Las estaciones
days.work: Learn the four seasons and match months to seasons for California and for Argentina, explaining why they are reversed.

days.title: Weather report
days.work: Read a Spanish-language weather forecast for Mexico City and Buenos Aires and record the temperature and conditions for both.

days.title: El pronóstico
days.work: Write and record a 45-second TV-style weather report for three Spanish-speaking capitals, using the date and time.

days.title: Unit 2 assessment
days.work: Take the unit test on days, months, dates, time, and weather, including a listening section.

weeks.assessment: Unit 2 test and weather report recording.

weeks.topic: Subject pronouns and the verb ser

days.title: Subject pronouns
days.work: Learn the subject pronouns (including vosotros in Spain and ustedes in Latin America) and assign the correct pronoun to 20 pictures of people.

days.title: Ser
days.work: Learn soy, eres, es, somos, sois, son; complete a Conjuguemos ser drill until you score 90%.

days.title: Ser for origin
days.work: Write 10 sentences about where people are from using ser de (Shakira es de Colombia...).

days.title: Pair questions
days.work: Answer and ask ¿Eres...? yes/no questions with a parent, practicing no + verb for negatives.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a ser conjugation and pronoun quiz.

objectives: Make adjectives agree in gender and number

days.title: Personality words
days.work: Learn 16 personality adjectives with flashcards and describe yourself in five sentences using soy and no soy.

days.title: Agreement
days.work: Learn masculine/feminine and singular/plural adjective endings (-o/-a/-os/-as, -e, consonant) and complete a 20-item agreement worksheet.

days.title: Intensifiers
days.work: Add muy, un poco, bastante, and pero/y to describe three family members in connected sentences.

days.title: Entrevista
days.work: Interview a parent: ¿Cómo eres? ¿Eres...? and write a five-sentence description of them from the answers.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take an adjective agreement quiz and record a 30-second self-description.

days.title: Physical traits
days.work: Learn alto, bajo, rubio, moreno, pelirrojo, tiene el pelo/los ojos... and describe 6 magazine photos.

days.title: Articles
days.work: Learn el/la/los/las and un/una/unos/unas and complete a sorting activity with 20 nouns.

days.title: Nationalities
days.work: Learn 12 nationality adjectives and their agreement (español/española) and write who each famous person is and where they are from.

days.title: ¿Quién es?
days.work: Play a guess-who game with a parent using only Spanish yes/no questions about appearance and personality.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a reading quiz: read four short profiles and match each to the correct picture.

weeks.assessment: Reading comprehension quiz and guess-who participation.

weeks.topic: Proyecto: Una persona famosa del mundo hispano
objectives: Present a description in simple sentences

days.title: Choose and research
days.work: Choose a figure (e.g., Frida Kahlo, Lionel Messi, Sonia Sotomayor, Ellen Ochoa) and collect five facts in English, then key Spanish words.

days.title: Write
days.work: Write an 8–10 sentence profile in Spanish using ser, nationalities, personality, and physical description.

days.title: Revise
days.work: Check adjective agreement and articles with a checklist; look up three new words on SpanishDict.

days.title: Present
days.work: Create a poster or 3-slide presentation and practice presenting it without reading word for word.

days.title: Unit 3 assessment
days.work: Present the profile (1–2 minutes) and take the unit 3 written test on ser and adjective agreement.

weeks.topic: ¿Qué te gusta hacer? Activities and gustar
objectives: Say what you and others like to do

days.title: Actividades
days.work: Learn 18 activity infinitives with picture cards and act them out for a parent to guess.

days.title: Me gusta / no me gusta
days.work: Write 10 sentences: Me gusta nadar, No me gusta cantar, Me gusta más leer.

days.title: ¿Te gusta...?
days.work: Ask a family member ten ¿Te gusta...? questions and record answers in a chart.

days.title: Listening
days.work: Listen to two teens on a Spanish podcast or video describe hobbies and note each one's likes and dislikes.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a vocabulary and gustar quiz.

weeks.topic: A mí también, a mí tampoco: agreeing, disagreeing, and le gusta
objectives: Agree and disagree with others' likes
Report others' likes with le gusta

days.title: También/tampoco
days.work: Learn a mí también, a mí tampoco, a mí sí/no and practice reacting to 15 statements read by a parent.

days.title: Le gusta
days.work: Use a él/a ella le gusta to report what three relatives like; write a paragraph about each.

days.title: Negatives
days.work: Practice no...nada, ni...ni, and tampoco in 10 written sentences.

days.title: Encuesta
days.work: Survey five people (in person or by video call) on their favorite activities and graph the results with Spanish labels.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Hold a 2-minute unscripted conversation about likes and dislikes and take a short writing check.

weeks.assessment: Interpersonal conversation rubric and writing check.

weeks.topic: Unit 4: Free time in the Spanish-speaking world
objectives: Compare teen free-time activities across cultures
Write a pen-pal email about likes

days.title: Culture reading
days.work: Read about popular pastimes (fútbol in Argentina, béisbol in the Dominican Republic, paseo in Spain) and list three products and practices.

days.title: Señor Wooly
days.work: Watch a free Señor Wooly music video, identify every activity word you hear, and summarize the story in five English sentences.

days.title: Pen-pal email
days.work: Write a 10-sentence email to a pen pal introducing yourself and your likes and asking three questions.

days.title: Comparación
days.work: Make a Venn diagram comparing your free time with a teen in Mexico or Spain, then write three comparison sentences in Spanish.

days.title: Unit 4 assessment
days.work: Take the unit test: listening to likes, reading a pen-pal letter, and writing a reply.

weeks.assessment: Unit 4 test and pen-pal email rubric.

weeks.topic: En la clase: classroom objects, gender, plurals, and hay

days.title: Objects
days.work: Label 20 school supplies and furniture at home with sticky notes in Spanish with el/la.

days.title: Plurals
days.work: Learn plural rules (-s, -es, lápiz→lápices) and write the plural of 20 nouns.

days.title: Hay
days.work: Describe your backpack and desk using hay and numbers: En mi mochila hay dos cuadernos y un lápiz.

days.title: Classroom commands
days.work: Learn and respond physically to 12 classroom expressions (Saquen una hoja, ¿Cómo se dice...?, Repitan) in a TPR game.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a vocabulary, plural, and hay quiz.

weeks.topic: Mi horario: school subjects and numbers to 100

days.title: Subjects
days.work: Learn the school subjects and ordinal numbers 1st–8th and fill out your weekly schedule in Spanish with times.

days.title: Números 32–100
days.work: Learn tens and combinations (treinta y dos ... cien) and play number bingo with a parent.

days.title: Opinions
days.work: Write opinions about each subject using es interesante/difícil/aburrida and me gusta.

days.title: Culture: la escuela
days.work: Read about school in Mexico or Chile (uniforms, recreo, schedules) and list four differences from your homeschool day.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Answer schedule questions in a short interview and take a numbers-to-100 dictation.

days.title: -ar endings
days.work: Learn infinitive, stem, and endings (-o, -as, -a, -amos, -áis, -an) and conjugate hablar and estudiar in a chart.

days.title: Drill
days.work: Complete Conjuguemos -ar verb practice until you score 90%, then write 10 original sentences.

days.title: Who does what?
days.work: Describe what each family member does on a weekday using -ar verbs and time expressions.

days.title: Questions
days.work: Form yes/no and question-word questions (¿Qué estudias? ¿Cuándo trabajas?) and interview a parent.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take an -ar verb conjugation and sentence-writing quiz.

days.title: Review: units 1–2
days.work: Review greetings, numbers, dates, time, and weather with a self-made flashcard set and a practice listening quiz.

days.title: Review: units 3–5
days.work: Review ser, adjectives, gustar, classroom vocabulary, and -ar verbs with a practice test.

days.title: Speaking exam
days.work: Do a 3-minute interpersonal interview with a parent covering name, origin, personality, likes, and schedule.

days.title: Written exam
days.work: Take the semester written exam (listening, reading, grammar, and a 10-sentence writing prompt).

days.title: Reflection
days.work: Fill in a can-do checklist for semester 1 and set two goals for semester 2.

weeks.topic: El desayuno y el almuerzo: food vocabulary
objectives: Say what you eat and drink

days.title: Breakfast foods
days.work: Learn 12 breakfast foods and drinks and label a picture of your own breakfast.

days.title: Lunch foods
days.work: Learn 12 lunch foods and drinks and sort all foods into a category chart (frutas, verduras, carnes, bebidas).

days.title: Me encanta / me gustan
days.work: Learn me gusta(n) and me encanta(n) with plural nouns and write 10 sentences about foods.

days.title: Encuesta
days.work: Ask three family members ¿Qué comes en el desayuno? and summarize the answers.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a food vocabulary and gustar/encantar quiz.

objectives: Talk about eating and drinking habits

days.title: -er verbs
days.work: Learn the -er endings and conjugate comer, beber, and leer in a chart.

days.title: -ir verbs
days.work: Learn the -ir endings, noting nosotros -imos, and conjugate vivir, escribir, compartir.

days.title: Drill
days.work: Complete Conjuguemos -er/-ir practice to 90%, then write 10 sentences with frequency words (siempre, a veces, nunca).

days.title: Interview
days.work: Interview a parent about their eating habits with eight questions using -er/-ir verbs.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take an -ar/-er/-ir conjugation quiz.

weeks.topic: Para mantener la salud: healthy eating and plural adjectives
objectives: Use plural adjectives and ser with foods

days.title: Comida sana
days.work: Learn 12 vegetable and protein words and classify foods as bueno/malo para la salud.

days.title: Plural adjectives
days.work: Describe 10 foods with ser and agreeing adjectives: Las zanahorias son sabrosas.

days.title: Nutrition labels
days.work: Read a Spanish nutrition label (información nutricional) and answer questions about grasa, azúcar, and calorías.

days.title: Mi plato
days.work: Draw a balanced plate and write a 6-sentence description of a healthy lunch, using para mantener la salud debes...

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a reading quiz on a short healthy-eating article and present your plate orally.

objectives: Identify traditional foods of several countries

days.title: Regional foods
days.work: Research one traditional dish each from Mexico, Spain, Venezuela, and Peru and add photos and captions to your map.

days.title: Tortilla: two meanings
days.work: Compare the Mexican corn tortilla and the Spanish tortilla española; write five comparison sentences.

days.title: El mercado
days.work: Watch a video of a Latin American market and list 10 foods you recognize in Spanish.

days.title: Cocina
days.work: Prepare a simple recipe (guacamole or tortilla española) with a parent, narrating each step in Spanish.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Write a short reflection comparing a family meal tradition with one you studied.

materials: paper or slides for a menu

days.title: Menu design
days.work: Design a bilingual café menu with 12 items and prices in pesos or euros.

days.title: Descriptions
days.work: Write a one-sentence Spanish description for each menu item using adjectives.

days.title: Ordering chunks
days.work: Learn the chunks ¿Qué quieres comer? and Quisiera... and practice ordering from your menu.

days.title: Role-play
days.work: Run a café role-play with a family member as customer, using numbers for prices.

days.title: Unit 6 test
days.work: Take the unit 6 test: food listening, -er/-ir verbs, and a short writing on your eating habits.

weeks.assessment: Menu project rubric and unit 6 test.

days.title: Family words
days.work: Learn 20 family words and label a photo collage of your family.

days.title: Relationships
days.work: Read a family tree of a fictional Spanish-speaking family and answer 10 ¿Quién es...? questions.

days.title: Describing family
days.work: Write six sentences describing family members' personalities and appearance with ser.

days.title: Mascotas
days.work: Add pets and describe them; share a short video tour of family photos in Spanish.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a family vocabulary quiz.

weeks.topic: The verb tener and possessive adjectives

days.title: Tener
days.work: Learn the forms of tener (tengo, tienes...) and complete a Conjuguemos tener drill.

days.title: Ages
days.work: Ask and answer ¿Cuántos años tiene...? for 10 family members and friends.

days.title: Possessives
days.work: Learn mi/tu/su/nuestro/vuestro and their plurals and complete a 20-item practice.

days.title: Conversation
days.work: Discuss your family with a parent: how many siblings, cousins, and pets, and who is older or younger.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a tener and possessives quiz.

days.title: Expressions
days.work: Learn tener hambre, sed, frío, calor, sueño, miedo, prisa, razón and caption 10 pictures.

days.title: Tener que
days.work: Write a to-do list using tener que + infinitive for each family member this week.

days.title: Celebrations
days.work: Read about the quinceañera and the cumpleaños tradition of las mañanitas; listen to Las mañanitas and write down five words you hear.

days.title: Mi fiesta
days.work: Describe your last family party in present-tense sentences: who is there, what they eat, what they have.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a tener expressions quiz with a listening section.

days.title: Apellidos
days.work: Learn how Spanish double surnames (apellido paterno y materno) work and write your name in that format.

days.title: Build the tree
days.work: Create a family tree poster with at least 12 relatives, labels, and ages.

days.title: Script
days.work: Write a 10–12 sentence presentation of your family using tener, ser, possessives, and gustar.

days.title: Rehearse
days.work: Practice presenting with notes on index cards (key words only) and record a practice run.

days.title: Unit 7 assessment
days.work: Present the family tree (2 minutes) and take the unit 7 written test.

weeks.assessment: Family tree presentation rubric and unit test.

days.title: Estar
days.work: Learn estoy, estás, está, estamos, estáis, están and when to use estar for location and feelings.

days.title: Prepositions
days.work: Place a stuffed animal in 12 locations and describe each: El gato está debajo de la mesa.

days.title: Where is it?
days.work: Hide five objects and give a parent Spanish clues to find them; then switch roles.

days.title: Ser vs. estar intro
days.work: Sort 15 sentences into ser (origin, description) or estar (location, feelings) and explain each choice.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take an estar and prepositions quiz.

objectives: Ask and say where places are

days.title: Places
days.work: Learn 16 places in a town and label a hand-drawn map of your neighborhood.

days.title: Map questions
days.work: Answer ¿Dónde está la biblioteca? questions using prepositions on your map.

days.title: La plaza
days.work: Read about the central plaza in Spanish and Latin American towns and compare it with a California downtown.

days.title: Virtual tour
days.work: Use Google Maps Street View to tour a plaza in Oaxaca or Salamanca and write 8 sentences about what is there.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a places vocabulary quiz with a map-reading section.

weeks.topic: ¿Adónde vas? The verb ir and question words
objectives: Say where people go and when

days.title: Ir
days.work: Learn voy, vas, va, vamos, vais, van and the contraction a + el = al.

days.title: Question words
days.work: Review ¿Qué? ¿Quién? ¿Dónde? ¿Adónde? ¿Cuándo? ¿Con quién? ¿Por qué? and write 10 questions about weekend plans.

days.title: My week
days.work: Fill a planner with where you go each day and write 7 sentences with ir and time expressions.

days.title: Interview
days.work: Interview a family member about where they go during the week and write a short report.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take an ir and question words quiz.

objectives: Read a city map in Spanish

days.title: Direction words
days.work: Learn derecha, izquierda, todo derecho, cuadra, esquina and follow parent's spoken directions around the house.

days.title: Map practice
days.work: Trace routes on a printed map of a Spanish city center as you listen to recorded directions.

days.title: Giving directions
days.work: Write directions from your house to three local places using memorized chunks (dobla a la derecha, sigue derecho).

days.title: Info gap
days.work: Play an information-gap map game with a parent: each has half the places and must ask ¿Dónde está...?

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take a listening quiz following directions on a map.

objectives: Create a guided tour of your town

days.title: Plan
days.work: Choose five places in your town and write two sentences about each: where it is and what people do there.

days.title: Record
days.work: Film or photograph the places and record a narrated tour in Spanish (2 minutes).

days.title: Reading
days.work: Read a short tourist brochure about a Spanish-speaking city and answer comprehension questions.

days.title: Conversation
days.work: Role-play a tourist asking a local for directions to three places.

days.title: Unit 8 test
days.work: Take the unit 8 test on estar, ir, places, and directions.

weeks.assessment: Town tour video rubric and unit test.

weeks.topic: Los deportes e ir a + infinitive
objectives: Talk about future plans with ir a + infinitive

days.title: Sports
days.work: Learn 12 sports and jugar a and describe which sports family members play.

days.title: Ir a + infinitive
days.work: Learn voy a jugar, vas a ver... and write 10 sentences about plans for next weekend.

days.title: Culture: fútbol
days.work: Read about a famous soccer rivalry (Real Madrid–Barcelona or Boca–River) and summarize it in five Spanish sentences.

days.title: Plans calendar
days.work: Make a two-week plans calendar and tell a parent your plans using time expressions.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Take an ir a + infinitive quiz.

days.title: Invitation chunks
days.work: Learn ¿Quieres ir...?, ¡Claro que sí!, Lo siento, no puedo, tengo que... and practice in pairs.

days.title: Texting
days.work: Write a Spanish text-message exchange inviting a friend to a game, including time and place.

days.title: Phone call
days.work: Make a simulated phone call to invite a family member to an event and respond to their excuse.

days.title: Cultural norms
days.work: Read about punctuality and social plans in Latin America and Spain and discuss differences.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Hold a recorded unscripted invitation conversation.

days.title: Review: units 1–5
days.work: Review greetings, calendar, ser, gustar, school, and -ar verbs with a practice test.

days.title: Review: units 6–9
days.work: Review food, -er/-ir verbs, family, tener, estar, ir, and ir a + infinitive with Conjuguemos drills.

days.title: Reading practice
days.work: Read three short Spanish texts (menu, family profile, town brochure) and answer questions.

days.title: Speaking practice
days.work: Do a mock 3-minute interview covering all topics of the year.

days.title: Writing practice
days.work: Write a practice paragraph about yourself, your family, and your weekend plans.

objectives: Demonstrate Novice Mid proficiency in all three modes

days.title: Interpretive
days.work: Read an authentic text (a pen-pal profile or town website) and listen to a short audio, answering comprehension questions.

days.title: Interpersonal
days.work: Hold a 4-minute conversation with a parent about yourself, family, school, food, and plans.

days.title: Presentational
days.work: Write and present 'Mi vida' (12–15 sentences) covering all 1A topics.

days.title: Cultures
days.work: Present one cultural comparison from the year (food, greetings, plazas, or celebrations).

days.title: Reflection
days.work: Complete a can-do self-assessment and set goals for Spanish 1B.

weeks.assessment: Integrated performance assessment rubric (interpretive, interpersonal, presentational).
